method: Static receipt accounting from 44 completed English primary reports and sealed input role maps. Planned minima stay context only. Path/SHA values are owner declarations; no helper image opening, hashing, remote execution or verification.

baseline_imported_receipt.primary_opens_equation: 725 = 427 candidate + 271 design/related-reference + 3 own-closed original + 24 owner processed/expected original.
baseline_imported_receipt.scope: Reported completion of existing primary receipts only; this proposal awards no case, fresh-view, candidate, full-round, clean-round or R2 credit.

current_freeze_owner_declared.authority: Existing owner declarations only. All 44 incremental reports declare the same source/run/round/binary tuple; no helper hash computation or byte verification.

checkpoint_receipt.equation: 1006 = 510 candidate + 335 design/related-reference + 3 own-closed + 88 processed source + 70 expected/oracle.

necessary_reading_pending.predicate: Chapter metadata ending after the visible 8: complete ellipsis versus clipping.
necessary_reading_pending.reason: The terminal marks are not sufficiently clear in the actual full original and supplied exact-scale crop to establish either conclusion.
necessary_reading_pending.disposition: Retain pending for coordinator adjudication; no additional view or evidence production in this assignment.

closed.disposition: Assigned terminal-ellipsis/right-boundary reading closed in the limited Root09 predicate; no clipping defect established.

partially_closed.disposition: Chapter-ending after 8 remains necessary reading for Local fixture series 000/002/004; no clipping defect, font cause or numeric repair target.

retained_global_disposition.policy: Preserve existing raw reports, prior Root decisions and limited predicates. No new raw finding can be waived without Root fresh adjudication.
